From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 04 Jul 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps & 30-min product briefing — two stakeholder time choices

Hi Laura / Rajiv —

Thanks again for the productive discovery this morning. Quick recap and a practical next step so we keep momentum:

Key takeaways:
- Primary goal: evaluate Redwood Inference for low-latency inference on clinical summarization workloads (target: <200ms tail for short prompts).
- Success criteria: latency profile, predictable cost per token, and secure data handling (SOC2 + VPC options).
- Internal stakeholders to include for the briefing: product owner (Laura), engineering lead (Rajiv), and optionally security/infra (we can keep this lightweight).

Proposed next step: 30-minute product briefing (brief walkthrough of runtime, routing, and analytics + short Q&A). Two concrete options to pick from:

Option A — Wed Jul 6 | 10:00–10:30 PT (13:00–13:30 ET) — good for product + early ops
Option B — Thu Jul 7 | 15:00–15:30 PT (18:00–18:30 ET) — better for Rajiv & infra folks who prefer later in the day

I attached a short 1-pg agenda and a draft mutual action plan (MAP) to make logistics easy. You can also pick a slot via my calendar link: https://cal.redwood.ai/s/stephanie-nguyen/30

Ask: please reply with your preferred option and confirm who will join from your side (name + role). If neither works, tell me two 30-min windows that do.

Attachments: redwood-30m-brief-agenda.pdf, mutual-action-plan-nimbus.xlsx

Thanks — happy to loop in Aditya (copied) for any pricing/commit questions.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.ai
